title: Android Smoke Regression Harness
problem: Android has single-state emulator smoke fixtures, but no documented local regression command that composes the stable setup, shell, and server-backed media states into one repeatable confidence gate.
summary: Local Android smoke regression wrapper and failure handoff behavior are implemented; next step is closeout.

evidence.notes: Planning and local regression boundary freeze.
Full local smoke regression passed for empty-setup, profile-missing-token, and profile-with-media.
Failure classification and focus recovery validated with controlled failure and successful two-state local regression.

continue_policy.notes: Continue through ASR-020/ASR-030 while the scope remains a local wrapper around existing smoke fixture states. Split CI, golden visual diffing, and deeper playback validation into separate lanes.
